subject: Tenant retention zone override proposal
messages:
From: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@fincorp.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@fincorp.com>; FinCorp Compliance <compliance@fincorp.com>
Date: 2028-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: per-tenant retention overrides + regional persistency options

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. As we scope our pilot we have a short list of compliance asks from our legal/compliance teams: the ability to set retention overrides per tenant (not just per-workspace) so we can keep a small subset of regulated tenants in-region for longer, and an "exemption/hold" flag for tenants under audit that prevents auto-deletion while preserving audit logs.

Can Redwood support:
- A per-tenant retention override that can be set to a longer TTL than the workspace default
- A regional storage pin (US-only) for specific tenants even if workspace default is multi-region
- A programmatic API + UI admin flow to request temporary holds for a tenant (with attachments for justification)

We attached an internal PDF with examples and a rough deadline (end of May) for the pilot. This is currently blocking our compliance sign-off. Could you outline what the effort looks like and whether this is feasible as part of the Q2 roadmap?

Appreciate it —
Erin Walsh
Director, Cloud Compliance
FinCorp
Attachment: tenant-exemption-request.pdf

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@fincorp.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com; karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: per-tenant retention overrides + regional persistency options

Hi Erin — thanks for the clear summary and the PDF. Looping in Product (Laura) and Infra (Karthik) to assess feasibility and timeline.

Quick answers up front:
- We can add a per-tenant retention parameter in the control plane; it will require API + admin UI work and changes to the deletion service to respect tenant-level overrides.
- Pinning storage region per-tenant is possible but depends on customer tenancy mapping to physical storage pools; we have partial support today via per-workspace residency.
- Temporary holds (legal hold) are doable; we need to clarify retention semantics (prevent deletion vs. extend TTL) and audit export hooks.

Laura/Karthik — can you take a first-pass on dev effort and whether we can scope a minimal implementation (API + soft UI) for end-of-May for a pilot? I'll own coordination with FinCorp and paperwork.

Thanks,
Markus
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>; laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-18T13:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: per-tenant retention overrides + regional persistency options

Markus — thanks for the ping. Technical summary and constraints below.

What is feasible (short path):
- Add tenant-level TTL field in control plane and surface API endpoint: PATCH /v1/tenants/:id/retention
- Deletion worker to check tenant TTL before purging — small runtime change (1-2 sprints); needs test coverage for mixed TTLs within a workspace
- Temporary hold: toggle on tenant metadata that prevents deletion; we already have a soft-delete window, so hold can set an explicit guard flag.

Harder items (longer tail):
- Pinning physical storage region per tenant requires mapping tenant -> storage pool at write time. If tenant data is already sharded into multi-region buckets, we either need a migration OR keep a logical pointer and copy-on-write for new data. Migration could be costly for large tenants.
- Admin UI: straightforward but needs RBAC controls and an approval workflow for holds.

Attachments: I sketched a candidate effort matrix (retention-override-matrix.csv) with estimated story points and dependencies.

Questions for FinCorp:
1) How many tenants need pinning? Rough size/volume?
2) For holds: is the expectation that historic data must be moved into-region or is preventing deletion of existing copies sufficient?

Estimate (minimal pilot): 2 sprints infra + 1 sprint product + 1 sprint QA (if scope limited to API + hold flag + simple UI). Migration or large-scale rehydration adds 2–4 additional sprints.

- Karthik
Senior Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
Attachment: retention-override-matrix.csv

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>; karthik.iyer@redwood.com; priyom.das@redwood.com; marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-19T09:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: per-tenant retention overrides + regional persistency options

Thanks — added product perspective.

Suggested scope for a pilot (to meet FinCorp timeline):
- Phase 1 (pilot): Tenant-level TTL override + legal-hold flag + API endpoints + basic admin UI to set and revoke holds. No bulk migration. Prioritize audit logs (who toggled hold, timestamp) and an export endpoint for compliance.
- Phase 2: Region pinning for new data + optional migration tooling (post-pilot)

Risks:
- UX friction: admin needs audit/approval flow to avoid accidental holds.
- Cost: keeping data in-region for longer increases storage cost; we should add a cost-estimate view in the UI.

I propose we mark this as "medium" priority for the infra roadmap and commit to the API + hold flag for pilot. Priyom — can you scope the admin approval flow (one-pager) and estimate UI work? Marissa, please coordinate legal/Docs changes.

Laura Bennett
Product Manager, Data Controls

From: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@fincorp.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>; Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@fincorp.com>
Cc: FinCorp Compliance <compliance@fincorp.com>
Date: 2028-04-19T11:36:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: per-tenant retention overrides + regional persistency options

Markus / team — quick clarification from our side:
- ~8 pilot tenants (small-mid), combined dataset ~3TB, most historical data already multi-region. For audit holds, preventing deletion of existing copies is sufficient for now; migrating terabytes is not required for the pilot.
- We need a simple mailbox-based approval flow (record of approval email is fine) for the pilot; a more formal approval workflow can follow.

If you can deliver Phase 1 by end of May that should unblock our compliance sign-off. Happy to be flexible on UI polish as long as the API + logs + hold semantics exist.

Thanks,
Tom
Senior Product Ops, FinCorp

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@fincorp.com>; Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@fincorp.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com; karthik.iyer@redwood.com; priyom.das@redwood.com; marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-20T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: per-tenant retention overrides + regional persistency options

Thanks all — alignment noted. Action items and tentative timeline:

1) Karthik / Infra: Implement tenant TTL override + hold flag and deletion-worker guard (ETA: 2 sprints) — owner: karthik. Attachment: retention-override-matrix.csv
2) Priyom / Product infra: Minimal admin UI to set/revoke hold and attach evidence (email/pdf) + audit log export (ETA: 1 sprint) — owner: priyom
3) Laura / Product: Draft pilot acceptance criteria and docs; include cost estimate widget (ETA: end of next week) — owner: laura
4) Markus: I'll coordinate the pilot onboarding and create HubSpot record HS-47290 (link included).

FinCorp: we'll target an internal demo by May 24 and a gated pilot deployment that week. If anything shifts on your side on scope or dataset size please flag ASAP.

I'll follow up with a short spec doc and PRD link. Thanks for the quick responses.

—Markus
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
